items.title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
items.title_cn: 少解码器多编码器：从新颖视图合成中学习几何表示
items.summary: This paper examines the role of Novel View Synthesis (NVS) in geometric representation learning. In principle, NVS should reason about 3D scene structure, thereby enabling transferable multi-view geometric representations. Yet, existing encoder-based NVS methods yield poor representations. items.summary_cn: 本文研究了新视图合成（ NVS ）在几何表示学习中的作用。原则上， NVS应该对3D场景结构进行推理，从而实现可转移的多视图几何表示。然而，现有的基于编码器的NVS方法表现不佳。...

items.summary: We introduce 4DCodeBench, a benchmark for 4D inverse graphics through code generation, in which agents reconstruct dynamic scenes from video as executable graphics programs. To accomplish this, agents must translate visual observations into compact representations of scene structure and dynamics, by...
